method: Linear upper/lower contours only between consecutive native columns with unique one-to-one overlapping native depth runs and finite paired boundaries; geodesic strip lengths on mean-radius sphere6371008.8m. No lateral endpoint closure or split/merge interpolation.
range_interpretation: Sampling-bracket geometry scenarios under the same linear-contour assumption; not statistical confidence, physical uncertainty, annual envelope or guaranteed true-area bounds.
interpretation: Partial model signed-component section geometry at the original0.1m/s cutoff, not physical current area/width/thickness or a whole-section area. Missing and ambiguous patches remain gaps. Areas from different sections/dates/owners must not be summed into water volume.
